[[File:Terapagos's Exploration Diary.png|thumb|250px|Japanese logo]] '''Terapagos's Exploration Diary''' (Japanese: '''テラパゴスのキラキラ{{ruby|探検記|たんけんき}}''' ''Terapagos's Brilliant Exploration Diary'') is a series of three {{pkmn|animation|animated shorts}} focusing on {{an|Terapagos}} that were shown at the end of episodes in the Japanese version of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', replacing the regular [[bonus segment]] [[Professor Friede's Pokémon Seminar]] from [[HZ031]] to [[HZ033]], which originally aired from December 1 to December 15, 2023. The shorts were also uploaded separately to the official Japanese Pokémon X (formerly Twitter) account to promote a playlist of episodes featuring Terapagos that were available on the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel from December 1 to 15, 2023. They were subsequently released with Japanese audio and English, Traditional Chinese, and Indonesian subtitles on the official Asian Pokémon YouTube channels on December 25, 2024. The Pokémon Asia ENG uploads additionally include an advertisement for the {{TCG|Stellar Crown}} TCG expansion and ''Pokémon Horizons: The Series''. ==List of segments== {{Episodelistheader|SV}} {{Episodelistbody|HZ031|[[#Vol. 1|Terapagos's Exploration Diary Vol. 1]]|テラパゴスのキラキラ探検記|Terapagos's Brilliant Exploration Diary|None|December 1, 2023|TED1.png}} {{Episodelistbody|HZ032|[[#Vol. 2|Terapagos's Exploration Diary Vol. 2]]|テラパゴスのキラキラ探検記 vol.2|Terapagos's Brilliant Exploration Diary vol.2|None|December 8, 2023|TED2.png}} {{Episodelistbody|HZ033|[[#Vol. 3|Terapagos's Exploration Diary Vol. 3]]|テラパゴスのキラキラ探検記 vol.3|Terapagos's Brilliant Exploration Diary vol.3|None|December 15, 2023|TED3.png}} {{Episodelistfooterspecial|SV|This concludes Terapagos's Exploration Diary.}} ==Vol. 1== [[File:TED1.png|thumb|266px|Vol. 1]] '''Vol. 1''' was shown with [[HZ031]]. ===Summary=== Terapagos follows {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} throughout the [[Brave Olivine]]. Sprigatito is annoyed at first, but eventually accepts Terapagos's company, even letting it sleep next to her. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Liko]] (face never shown) ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Sprigatito}} ({{OP|Liko|Sprigatito}}) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Friede]]'s; [[Captain Pikachu]]) * {{p|Chansey}} ({{OP|Mollie|Chansey}}) * {{p|Terapagos}} ({{an|Terapagos|anime}}; {{form|Terapagos|Normal Form}}) * {{p|Noctowl}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Carkol}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Slugma}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Nosepass}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') ===Video=== This short was uploaded with the description "Let's check out what Terapagos and Sprigatito are getting up to!" (Japanese: '''ニャオハとテラパゴスの日常を覗いてみよう！'''). {{YouTubeVid|PKzwRhfx2m8|PokémonAsiaENG|scarlet|violet}} ==Vol. 2== [[File:TED2.png|thumb|266px|Vol. 2]] '''Vol. 2''' was shown with [[HZ032]]. ===Summary=== Terapagos explores the [[Brave Olivine]] at night, finding the other Pokémon sleeping together. {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}} rolls over in his sleep and bumps into {{p|Snorunt}}, who is startled and freezes over the floor with {{m|Ice Beam}}, causing Terapagos to slide around with Fuecoco, until they bump into a box of [[Oran Berry|Oran Berries]]. [[Roy]] and [[Captain Pikachu|Pikachu]] later find the Pokémon as they're eating the Berries together. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Roy]] (face never shown) ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Fuecoco}} ({{OP|Roy|Fuecoco}}) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Friede]]'s; [[Captain Pikachu]]) * {{p|Elekid}} ([[Orla]]'s) * {{p|Terapagos}} ({{an|Terapagos|anime}}; {{form|Terapagos|Normal Form}}) * {{p|Pawmi}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Snorunt}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Muk}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') ===Video=== This short was uploaded with the description "A sudden turn of events puts Terapagos in an unexpected situation!" (Japanese: '''突如アクシデントに襲われたテラパゴスの行方は……!?'''). {{YouTubeVid|TuDb5Hngmdo|PokémonAsiaENG|scarlet|violet}} ==Vol. 3== [[File:TED3.png|thumb|266px|Vol. 3]] '''Vol. 3''' was shown with [[HZ033]]. ===Summary=== Feeling hungry, Terapagos wanders into the [[Brave Olivine]]'s kitchen, where {{TP|Murdock|Alcremie}} produces some cream for it and {{TP|Murdock|Rockruff}}, while {{p|Shuckle}} gives them some of its [[Berry Juice|juice]]. The cream and the juice end up spilling all over the kitchen, much to the horror of {{TP|Dot|Quaxly}}, who tries to clean up the mess, but fails. Eventually, [[Dot]] enters the kitchen to find it and the Pokémon covered in cream and juice. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Dot]] (face never shown) ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Quaxly}} ({{OP|Dot|Quaxly}}) * {{p|Rockruff}} ({{OP|Murdock|Rockruff}}) * {{p|Alcremie}} ({{OP|Murdock|Alcremie}}; {{form|Alcremie|Strawberry Ruby Swirl}}) * {{p|Quagsire}} ([[Ludlow]]'s) * {{p|Terapagos}} ({{an|Terapagos|anime}}; {{form|Terapagos|Normal Form}}) * {{p|Shuckle}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') ===Video=== This short was uploaded with the description "Another busy day for Quaxly aboard the Brave Olivine airship!" (Japanese: '''賑やかなブレイブアサギ号で、クワッスは今日も大忙し！'''). {{YouTubeVid|RNZvDSWnrQ8|PokémonAsiaENG|scarlet|violet}} ==Trivia== * These segments follow the same style as ''[[PK01|Pikachu's Vacation]]'' or ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]'', where {{AP|Pikachu}} and the Pokémon from the main characters are the protagonists and the [[human]] characters appear briefly (usually from the back or with their faces not shown in the short). ** They are the first shorts from the animated series to star only Pokémon since ''[[Where Are You Going, Eevee?]]'', almost four years earlier. * The Pokémon Asia ENG uploads of the shorts mispell the video titles as ''Terapagos's Exploratoin day Vol. 1'',[https://web.archive.org/web/20241225010744/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PKzwRhfx2m8 [Official] Terapagos's Exploratoin day Vol. 1 🩵 ｜Pokémon Horizons: The Series (archived)] ''Terapagos's Exploratoin day vol.2'',[https://web.archive.org/web/20241225010744/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TuDb5Hngmdo [Official] Terapagos's Exploratoin day vol.2 🩵🩵 ｜Pokémon Horizons: The Series (archived)] and ''Terapagos's Exploratoin Diary vol.3''.[https://web.archive.org/web/20241225010744/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RNZvDSWnrQ8 [Official] Terapagos's Exploratoin Diary vol.3 🩵🩵🩵｜Pokémon Horizons: The Series (archived)] However, the video thumbnail and subtitles spell the title correctly. ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{colorschemedark|Paldea}}|bordercolor={{colorschemelight|Paldea}} |zh_cmn={{tt|太樂巴戈斯的亮晶晶探險記|Terapagos's Brilliant Exploration Diary}} |id={{tt|Jurnal Penjelajahan Kilau-mengilau Terapagos|Terapagos's Brilliant Exploration Journal}} }} ==References== ==Related articles== {{Anime bonus segments}}
